pages.text: A crash shows where it hit: the front crumples, a side caves in, the back gets dented, and the paint scrapes off there. The harder the hit, the worse it gets: the glass nearest it $(l)cracks$(), then $(l)shatters$(), and the lamps there get smashed.
Head on: the hood crumpled, the windshield in pieces, both headlights out.

It's not only looks:$(li)Smashed headlights don't light the road; with one left it's dimmer$(li)A smashed lamp's turn signal stops blinking$(li)A car bent badly on one side $(4)pulls$() toward it$(li)An engine worn below about a third smokes from under the hood
Hit on the left: that side caved in, its window shattered.

Fix it all at a $(l:care/repair_bench)Repair Bench$(/l):$(li)$(item)Body Panel$()s take the dents out as they mend the body$(li)a $(item)Car Window$() mends one window, the shattered ones first$(li)a $(item)Car Light$() puts back one smashed lamp$(br2)$(l:business/insurance)Insurance$(/l) pays for crash damage, glass and lamps too.
One headlight left, and a smoking engine.
